findings.label: Physics not delta-time-scaled
findings.description: updateSnake() applies constant THRUST and MAX_SPEED per call with no dt factor. On monitors above or below 60 Hz the game runs proportionally faster or slower. Multiply thrust and position deltas by dt/16.67 or refactor to per-second units scaled by dtSec.

findings.label: Food not wrap-rendered
findings.description: drawFood() draws the orb at its raw coordinates with no ghost copies at edges. Add the same cardinal+corner ghost pattern used for body segments.

findings.label: Head missing diagonal corner ghosts
findings.description: drawSnake() draws head ghosts for the four cardinal edges but not the four corner cases. Add diagonal ghost draws matching the body segment pattern.

findings.label: keys object not cleared on restart
findings.description: transitionTo('PLAYING') resets snake, score, and particles but does not clear the keys map. If a player holds a movement key while pressing SPACE to restart, thrust is applied on the very first physics tick.
